responseBinding.questionText: Paragraph A
responseBinding.correctOptionText: The collection challenge posed by urban waste

rows.sourceExcerpt: Urban streets accumulated horse manure, mud, market waste and dust. Hand sweeping could move this mixture into heaps for collection, but the work was slow and exposed labourers to traffic and airborne dirt. Expanding towns wanted a machine that would gather material continuously while travelling. The challenge was not merely to rotate a brush. responseBinding.questionText: Paragraph B
